XAT QOG'OZI (rasmli bo'shliqlar):
'2nd August, ......'
'Dear Sue, How are you? I hope you got my postcard from Portugal. I had a very relaxing time there and felt great when I arrived back in the UK.'
'However, all that was spoilt when I came 1) [RASM: uy] ...... and found there 2) ...... ...... (be) a burglary. What a mess! The burglars 3) ...... ...... (break) the 4) [RASM: o'g'ri derazadan kirmoqda] ...... in my study to get into the house. They 5) ...... ...... (open) the 6) [RASM: o'g'ri fonar bilan seyf oldida] ...... and stolen all my jewellery. They 7) ...... ...... ...... (also/smash) my favourite vase and pulled most of my 8) [RASM: kitoblar uyumi] ...... out of the 9) [RASM: kitob javoni] ...... . Finally they 10) ...... ...... (throw) my 11) [RASM: kompyuter] ...... onto the floor and broken it. It was awful.'
'As I'm sure you can imagine, I was very shocked at the time. I'm feeling better now, though. I'm having a burglar alarm installed soon, and the 12) [RASM: ikki politsiyachi] ...... think they can get my jewellery back.'
'Well, I hope everything is okay with you. Do drop me a line when you have time. Love, Sheila'

⚠ Bu 8-unitdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon - past perfect.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete Sheila's letter with the past perfect and the words in the pictures (Unit 8, Writing Project).
exercises.instructionUz: Sheilaning xatini o'tgan tugallangan zamon va rasmlardagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring (8-unit, Yozuv loyihasi).
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI (to'ldirilgan):

2-avgust
Aziz Sue,
Qalaysan? Portugaliyadan yuborgan
otkritkamni olgansan deb umid
qilaman. U yerda juda yaxshi dam
oldim va Buyuk Britaniyaga
qaytganimda o'zimni ajoyib his
qildim.

Biroq, UYGA kelib O'G'IRLIK
BO'LGANINI topganimda hammasi
buzildi. Qanday tartibsizlik!
O'g'rilar uyga kirish uchun ish
xonamdagi DERAZANI SINDIRGAN edi.
Ular SEYFNI OChIB, barcha zargarlik
buyumlarimni o'g'irlagan edi. Ular
sevimli vazamni HAM SINDIRGAN va
KITOBLARIMNING ko'pini JAVONDAN
tortib olgan edi. Nihoyat, ular
KOMPYUTERIMNI polga TAShLAB,
sindirgan edi. Dahshatli edi.

Tasavvur qilganingdek, o'shanda juda
hayratda edim. Lekin hozir o'zimni
yaxshiroq his qilyapman. Tez orada
o'g'ri signalizatsiyasi o'rnattiraman,
va POLITSIYa zargarlik buyumlarimni
qaytarib ola olamiz deb o'ylaydi.

Xo'sh, hammasi yaxshi deb umid
qilaman. Vaqting bo'lganda albatta
yoz.
Muhabbat bilan, Sheila


JAVOBLAR:
  1 home
  2 had been
  3 had broken
  4 window
  5 had opened
  6 safe
  7 had also smashed
  8 books
  9 bookcase
  10 had thrown
  11 computer
  12 police

  ⚠ PAST PERFECT - 'had + V3':
  o'g'irlik Sheila KELIShIDAN OLDIN
  bo'lgan.
  ⚠ 'came HOME' - 'to' yo'q!


⚠ 'SPOILT':

  = buzilgan. spoil - spoilt/
  spoiled.


⚠ 'A BURGLARY' / 'A BURGLAR':

  = uy o'g'irligi / uy o'g'risi.


⚠ 'A STUDY':

  = ish xonasi (uyda).


⚠ 'A SAFE':

  = seyf (ot!).


⚠ 'TO SMASH':

  = sindirmoq (parchalab).


⚠ 'A VASE':

  = vaza. /vɑːz/.


⚠ "I'M HAVING ... INSTALLED":

  = o'rnattiraman (boshqa odam
  qiladi).


⚠ 'TO DROP SOMEBODY A LINE':

  = qisqa xat yozmoq.

patterns.exampleEn: When I came home, I found there had been a burglary.
The burglars had broken the window and opened the safe.
